preconditions.description: The dimensions of the table are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'DIMA' for c in row) for row in table)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the table contains one of the letters 'D', 'I', 'M', or 'A'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Poor Dima!' if not any('D' in row for row in table) else True
postconditions.description: If there is no 'D' in the table, Inna cannot go through 'DIMA' even once.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Poor Inna!' if any(is_infinite_path(table, start) for start in find_all_D_positions(table)) else True
postconditions.description: If there is an infinite path starting from any 'D', Inna can go through 'DIMA' infinitely many times.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max_paths_through_dima(table) if return_value not in ['Poor Dima!', 'Poor Inna!'] else True
postconditions.description: Otherwise, return the maximum number of times Inna can go through 'DIMA'.
